title: Combined arms groups
source: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-builders.md "Combined arms" (a group's `base` byte at +0x24 and its `value` at +0x28, read by the builder and CUnit::GetCombinedArmsBonus); the loader itself (CSubUnitDataBase, 0x5AE1C0) was not read, so other keys are not known to be refused

combined_arms.desc: the groups, in order: a unit type's unit_group names one

patterns.desc: a combined arms group, named by its key

base.desc: a base group: without a brigade of one a division has no combined arms bonus

value.desc: the bonus the group adds, a fraction
